title: Elements, Tags & Attributes
description: Learn the anatomy of HTML elements, opening and closing tags, void elements, and how attributes configure behavior and metadata.

objectives.statement: Identify the anatomy of an HTML element including opening tag, attributes, content, and closing tag.
Distinguish between container elements and void (self-closing) elements.

content.title: The Building Blocks of the Web
content.hook: Every button, image, paragraph, and form on the web is represented as an HTML element.
content.context: HTML syntax is based on elements configured with tags and attributes that instruct browsers how to construct the Document Object Model (DOM).
goals: Break down the anatomy of standard and void HTML elements.
Write properly formatted attribute key-value pairs.

content.title: Anatomy of an HTML Element

content.title: Summary & Next Steps
takeaways: HTML elements are defined by opening tags, attributes, content, and closing tags.
Void elements cannot hold child elements and do not use closing tags.
Attributes configure element behaviors, URLs, accessibility labels, and classes.
